name: Eco World Development Group Berhad
overview: 今年公司完成收购柔佛Kulai约935.241英亩永久工业地以开发Eco Business Park 8，并在新加坡成功标得Lorong Puntong / Sin Ming Avenue一幅约4,283.4平方米住宅用地；同时与JLG Investment Holdings相关公司成立合资平台，拟在澳洲及Iskandar Malaysia进行开发。另一方面，公司终止了雪兰莪Semenyih一幅约22.734英亩商业地的收购。
overview_en: During the year, the company completed the acquisition of approximately 935.241 acres of freehold industrial land in Kulai, Johor for the development of Eco Business Park 8, and successfully tendered for a residential land parcel of approximately 4,283.4 square metres at Lorong Puntong / Sin Ming Avenue in Singapore. It also formed joint-venture platforms with companies related to JLG Investment Holdings for developments in Australia and Iskandar Malaysia.

segments.name: 住宅
segments.note: 今年在新加坡标得一幅住宅用地，并终止了雪兰莪Semenyih一幅商业地的收购。
segments.note_en: During the year, the segment secured a residential land parcel in Singapore and terminated the acquisition of a commercial land parcel in Semenyih, Selangor.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Eco World Development (S) Pte Ltd获新加坡市区重建局颁发Lorong Puntong / Sin Ming Avenue一幅约4,283.4平方米土地的投标。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Eco World Development (S) Pte Ltd was awarded the tender for a land parcel of approximately 4,283.4 square metres at Lorong Puntong / Sin Ming Avenue by the Urban Redevelopment Authority of Singapore.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 终止以81%持股子公司Mutiara Balau Sdn Bhd收购雪兰莪Mukim Semenyih一幅约92,000平方米（约22.734英亩）永久商业地的买卖协议。
actions.text_en: Terminated the sale and purchase agreement for the acquisition of an approximately 92,000-square-metre (about 22.734-acre) freehold commercial land in Mukim Semenyih, Selangor by 81%-owned subsidiary Mutiara Balau Sdn Bhd.

segments.name: 工业
segments.note: 今年完成收购柔佛Kulai约935.241英亩永久工业地，用于开发Eco Business Park 8。
segments.note_en: During the year, the segment completed the acquisition of approximately 935.241 acres of freehold industrial land in Kulai, Johor for the development of Eco Business Park 8.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 上述约935.241英亩柔佛Kulai永久工业地收购于2026年6月26日完成。
actions.text_en: The acquisition of the approximately 935.241-acre freehold industrial land in Kulai, Johor was completed on 26 June 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Eco Business Park 8 Sdn Bhd收购柔佛Mukim Kulai约935.241英亩永久工业地的买卖协议于2026年6月11日成为无条件。
actions.text_en: The sale and purchase agreement for the acquisition of approximately 935.241 acres of freehold industrial land in Mukim Kulai, Johor by Eco Business Park 8 Sdn Bhd became unconditional on 11 June 2026.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年与JLG Investment Holdings相关公司成立合资平台，拟在澳洲及Iskandar Malaysia进行开发，并延长收购Eco World (Macquarie) Pty Ltd的截止日期。
segments.note_en: During the year, the group formed joint-venture platforms with companies related to JLG Investment Holdings for developments in Australia and Iskandar Malaysia, and extended the sunset date for the ac…

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 合资公司Versione Node Sdn Bhd收购Eco World (Macquarie) Pty Ltd 100%股权的买卖协议截止日期延长至2026年12月13日。
actions.text_en: The sunset date for the sale and purchase agreement for the acquisition of 100% equity interest in Eco World (Macquarie) Pty Ltd by joint-venture entity Versione Node Sdn Bhd was extended to 13 December 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 全资子公司Ascension Synergy Sdn Bhd与JLG Investment Holdings相关公司签订3份认购及股东协议，成立各持股50%的合资实体，在澳洲及Iskandar Malaysia进行开发。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Ascension Synergy Sdn Bhd entered into three subscription and shareholders' agreements with companies related to JLG Investment Holdings to establish 50%-owned joint-venture entities for developments in Australia and Iskandar Malaysia.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 通过与JLG Investment Holdings相关公司成立各持股50%的合资平台，集团将业务拓展至澳洲及Iskandar Malaysia的开发项目。
model_changes.text_en: Through the establishment of 50%-owned joint-venture platforms with companies related to JLG Investment Holdings, the group expanded its development activities to Australia and Iskandar Malaysia.
